event_records.description: The marketing team's revised Q4 budget is submitted to the CFO for approval.

cfo.name: CFO
cfo.persona_brief:
You are CFO.
The CFO pushed back on the original Q4 marketing budget, leading to a revised proposal eight percent lower. They have weekly meetings with the CMO and a decent working relationship. The CFO has not yet decided whether to approve the revised budget.

cmo.name: CMO
cmo.persona_brief:
You are CMO.
The CMO leads the marketing team and revised the Q4 budget downward by eight percent after the CFO's pushback. They have weekly meetings with the CFO and a decent working relationship. The CMO wants approval before the leadership offsite on the 21st.

resolution.question: Will Ostara Foods' CFO approve the marketing team's revised Q4 budget before the leadership offsite on the 21st?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CFO communicated approval of the revised Q4 budget to the CMO or marketing team before 2026-09-21T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
